snippet.title: Let's Sing 2026 - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🎶 Turn up the volume — Let’s Sing 2026 is here!

https://Letssing.world/2026

Sing solo, perform in duets, or compete locally with up to 4 players in the ultimate karaoke experience.
Featuring the latest chart hits and all-time classics — it’s your time to shine! 🌟

Available now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series S/X

#LetsSing2026 #SingTogether #KaraokeNight
